headline: Quiet day: EU leaders hold first AI summit in Dublin
body: A quiet Saturday. EU leaders held their first dedicated AI summit in Dublin, though it ended without formal conclusions, lifting Global Coordination by 0.13. Self-Destruction edged down and 1984 edged up. Horizon Balance was almost unchanged at -20.04, from -20.02.
movers_note: Self-Destruction -0.07, from the Dublin summit (-0.07). 1984 +0.06, from the summit (+0.06). Protector God -0.05, from older signals fading.
coming_up: EU leaders' retreat revisits AI, 5 Feb 2027
